title: How to Play the D Chord on Guitar
summary: JustinGuitar's beginner-oriented tutorial teaches the D major chord on guitar by guiding the learner through the exact three-finger shape and placement order: index finger on the 2nd fret of the G string, middle finger on the 2nd fret of the high E string, and ring finger on the 3rd fret of the B string. The video emphasizes placing fingers close to the frets, angling the knuckles, and avoiding muting by keeping the fingertips on the tips of the strings. It covers common beginner challenges such as finger pressure timing, muting issues on the open 4th string, and maintaining the thumb behind the neck to support future barre chords. A four-stage practice framework, called Chord Perfect Practice, is introduced to help learners lock in correct finger placement, refine tone through small adjustments, and solidify the strumming pattern.

sections.description: Outlines a four-stage practice system: (1) place the fingers in position without heavy pressing, (2) press and strum to hear the chord, (3) make small adjustments to improve clarity, and (4) perform a final strum while visualizing the correct finger placement to reinforce the habit.
